Application Data.NAME: Guardian Security Services LLC
Application Data.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: John Smith, Chief Operations Officer, Guardian Security Services LLC, (555) 123-4567, john.smith@guardiansecurity.com
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Guardian Security Services LLC specializes in providing comprehensive detective and security services, including on-site security personnel, private investigations, and risk assessments for residential, commercial, and industrial clients. Our team consists of fully licensed and experienced professionals committed to upholding the highest standards of ethical conduct and compliance with all applicable regulations. We prioritize the safety and security of our clients while employing advanced technologies and methodologies to effectively address their unique security challenges. Please note that we do not employ unlicensed private investigators or utilize drones for surveillance purposes, ensuring adherence to legal and operational guidelines.
